_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-02 10:36, after proving out the Ashta defense (MB98a) and reading the fauna list: "let's start with these on there planets: A Mossgnath thats trampling crops, put it down. Red Mile Mauler pack. Siren pack. Kreet Stalker defense"
_note: THE SIREN PACK, on Niira: set the bait, then hold while the pack comes to it. Not the Maulers' shape on purpose, so the two packs play differently. NARROW, as MB98a: pinned to the creature's own planet, so the words name the creature and the planet aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).

Creatures: LvlSiren (Starfield.esm, VeryAggressive), found 11-02 by gen_inspect. Lore (fandom): armoured, long-eared predators, native to Lantana VIII-b, brought to Niira by the UC Xenowarfare Division in the Colony War. Said once, in the briefing, as fact.
STAND-IN: place.planet 'Niira' is not in the closed planet table yet. Bait crate model is the stackable crate, approved.
A DRAFT ID: MB ids stop at two digits (MB99a was the last free one, 11-02), so this waits for gen_delve name, as missionboard33a became MB98a. The numbering cap is Eliza's to raise.

FRANCES 2026-11-02 (reviews/2026-11-02-delve-board45a.md): rework, findings 1-6 taken. The war history moved to the card, where every player reads it. Forced pick answered NO: the pack comes in two waves (squad, then horde), so the warden says they send a couple in first.

JAEGER PASS 2026-11-02, his 'If we know exactly where and what we can get sexy with it': the words use the planet's own lore (fandom, read the same day). Frances's 11-02 findings are kept; only lines were added.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Settlement Contract. Bait and hunt the Siren pack at the <Place> on <Planet>. The UC brought their kind here as weapons. Payment on contract completion."

place._planet: Niira, as its heading in data/delves/fauna.md (place.planet takes any heading since Eliza's ce5aee0).

prose.name: Hunt: Siren Pack on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A Siren pack has been working the ground around the <Place>. The site wants the pack drawn in and finished.
prose.card: A Siren pack is working the ground round the <Place>. Draw them in and finish them. The UC brought their kind here as weapons.

broadcast: You won't catch them, they're too clever for that. But they'll come to a meal. Put the bait out at the centre and wait. They send a couple in first to see what you do, and the rest follow.
The UC left them behind when the fighting stopped. Half of Niira burned in the war, and the Sirens are what lived through it.

beats.journal: I set the bait out at the <Place>. Now I need to hold the site when the Sirens come for it.
say: Bait's out. They'll smell it long before they hear you, so keep still.

beats.objective: Hold the site when the Siren pack comes in
beats.journal: The Siren pack came for the bait at the <Place>, and I put every one of them down.
